slub.title: Wedding ceremony
slub.desc2: Where? – Sanctuary of the Relics of the Tree of the Holy Cross

slub.question: Wedding ceremony– where and when?
slub.answer: It will take place on 24.04.2027 at 16:00  at the Sanctuary of the Relics of the Tree of the Holy Cross.  Link to Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/F8XGFVHXnKB7dPHbA

wesele.question: Wedding party – where and when?
wesele.answer: It will take place after the wedding, taking into account the time for the ride, it will be approx. 17:30. For this part of celebrating the next stage in our lives, we invite you to the Świętokrzyski Manor in Nowa Słupia. Link to Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/y3N128beyn8s4Abs7

theme.question: What is the theme of the wedding?
theme.answer: A traditional Slavic wedding with elements of The Lord of the Rings and The Witcher. We do not expect you to adapt your clothes, hairstyle, etc. to the subject matter. However, we encourage you to have fun as if it were a Slavic wedding ;)

parking.question: Is there parking on site?
parking.answer: Yes, free parking is available for all guests directly at the property.

rsvp.question: When should I confirm my arrival?
rsvp.answer: Please confirm your attendance by February 28th. The presence can be confirmed by phone, SMS or via a message on social media.

accommodation.question: Is there a place to stay?
accommodation.answer: Yes, for guests from outside the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, we provide accommodation from Saturday to Sunday. Check-in is available on April 24 from 14:00. Check-out is until 12:00 the next day (April 25).
